description: Defines the QuicSustainedBandwidthRecorder class which tracks and estimates sustained bandwidth in QUIC protocol implementation.

classes.name: QuicSustainedBandwidthRecorder
classes.description: Tracks and estimates sustained bandwidth over time for QUIC connections.

methods.name: RecordEstimate
methods.description: Records a bandwidth estimate, considering recovery and slow start states.

methods.name: HasEstimate
methods.description: Checks if a valid estimate exists.

methods.name: MaxBandwidthEstimate
methods.description: Returns the maximum bandwidth estimate observed.

methods.name: MaxBandwidthTimestamp
methods.description: Returns the timestamp of the maximum bandwidth estimate.

methods.name: EstimateRecordedDuringSlowStart
methods.description: Indicates if the estimate was recorded during slow start.
